title: m6A RNA methylation regulates the fate of endogenous retroviruses
model: Mouse ESCs with IAPEz-ERV blasticidin reporter, genome-wide KO
contrast: +blast vs -blast, Screen II late selection (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: m6A writers Mettl3/Mettl14/Wtap/Zc3h13 restrict IAP ERVs (top also apoptosis/heme genes)
barcs_calls: Top-ranked = apoptosis/heme selection genes; Mettl3 #11, Mettl14 #21 (median-ratio totals capped; hit count inflated)
named_hits: Mettl3 and Mettl14 recovered (top 21); Wtap, Zc3h13 not near top
verdict: BARCS recovers the m6A writers Mettl3 and Mettl14 and the blasticidin selection gene classes at the top, but the extreme clonal bottleneck in the +blast arm caps the median-ratio totals and inflates the hit count, so only the top enriched ranks are interpretable and overall agreement with the paper's MAGeCK is weak.
